title: Review Evolutionary conservation
text:
Visualize Conservation and Binding Pocket
This dashboard presents a visual representation of the Phytase (1DKP) crystal structure bound to it’s phytate ligand (IHP).
The scatter plot represents the alpha-carbon and ligand atom locations in 3-dimensional space.

Gray markers: All protein residues
Green markers: Residues within 7Å of the ligand
Purple markers: IHP ligand atoms

# Structure is hierarchical: Structure > Model > Chain > Residue > Atom

# Identify ligands (heteroatoms that are not water)
ligands = []

for chain in model:
    for residue in chain:
        # Get hetero flag: (' ', hetatm_flag, sequence_number)
        hetero_flag = residue.get_id()[0]
        
        # 'H_' prefix indicates heteroatom (ligand, ion, etc.)
        # 'W' indicates water
        if hetero_flag.startswith('H_'):
            residue_name = residue.get_resname()
            if residue_name != 'HOH':  # Exclude water molecules
                ligands.append({
                    'chain': chain.id,

import numpy as np

def find_residues_near_ligand(model, ligand_name='IHP', distance_threshold=7.0):
    """
    Find all amino acid residues within a specified distance of a ligand.
    
    Parameters:
    -----------
    model : Bio.PDB.Model
        The protein structure model
    ligand_name : str
        The name of the ligand to search around (default: 'IHP')
    distance_threshold : float
        Distance threshold in Angstroms (default: 7.0)
    
    Returns:
    --------
    list : List of dictionaries containing residue information
    """
    
    # Get all ligand atoms
    ligand_atoms = []
    for chain in model:
        for residue in chain:
            if residue.get_id()[0].startswith('H_') and residue.get_resname() == ligand_name:
                ligand_atoms.extend(list(residue.get_atoms()))
    
    if not ligand_atoms:
        print(f"No ligand '{ligand_name}' found in structure")
        return []
    
    # Find nearby residues
    nearby_residues = []
    
    for chain in model:
        for residue in chain:
            # Only check standard amino acids
            if residue.get_id()[0] == ' ':
                # Calculate minimum distance between any ligand atom and any residue atom
                min_distance = float('inf')
                
                for res_atom in residue.get_atoms():
                    res_coord = res_atom.get_coord()
                    
                    for lig_atom in ligand_atoms:
                        lig_coord = lig_atom.get_coord()
                        distance = np.linalg.norm(res_coord - lig_coord)
                        
                        if distance < min_distance:
                            min_distance = distance
                
                # If minimum distance is within threshold, add to list
                if min_distance <= distance_threshold:
                    nearby_residues.append({
                        'chain': chain.id,
                        'residue_name': residue.get_resname(),
                        'residue_number': residue.get_id()[1],
                        'residue_id': residue.get_id(),
                        'min_distance': round(min_distance, 2)
                    })
    
    # Sort by distance
    nearby_residues.sort(key=lambda x: x['min_distance'])
    
    return nearby_residues


# Find residues within 7 Angstroms of IHP ligand
nearby_residues = find_residues_near_ligand(model, ligand_name='IHP', distance_threshold=7.0)

# Display results
print(f"=== Amino Acids within 7 Å of IHP Ligand ===")
print(f"Total residues found: {len(nearby_residues)}\n")

for res in nearby_residues:
    print(f"Chain {res['chain']}: {res['residue_name']}{res['residue_number']} - {res['min_distance']} Å")

# Get residues near ligand (within 7 Å)
nearby_residues = find_residues_near_ligand(model, ligand_name='IHP', distance_threshold=7.0)

# Create a set of nearby residue IDs for quick lookup
nearby_residue_ids = set((res['chain'], res['residue_number']) for res in nearby_residues)

# Extract residue positions (using CA atoms for amino acids)
near_residue_coords = []
near_residue_labels = []
far_residue_coords = []
far_residue_labels = []
ligand_coords = []
ligand_names = []

for chain in model:
    for residue in chain:
        hetero_flag = residue.get_id()[0]
        
        # Handle ligand atoms (show all atoms)
        if hetero_flag.startswith('H_') and residue.get_resname() == 'IHP':
            for atom in residue:
                ligand_coords.append(atom.get_coord())
                ligand_names.append(f"{residue.get_resname()}-{atom.get_name()}")
        
        # Handle standard amino acids (show only CA atom position)
        elif hetero_flag == ' ':
            # Get CA (alpha carbon) atom to represent the residue
            if 'CA' in residue:
                ca_atom = residue['CA']
                coord = ca_atom.get_coord()
                label = f"{residue.get_resname()}{residue.get_id()[1]} ({chain.id})"
                
                # Check if this residue is near the ligand
                residue_key = (chain.id, residue.get_id()[1])
                if residue_key in nearby_residue_ids:
                    near_residue_coords.append(coord)
                    near_residue_labels.append(label)
                else:
                    far_residue_coords.append(coord)
                    far_residue_labels.append(label)

# Separate near residue coordinates
near_x = [coord[0] for coord in near_residue_coords]
near_y = [coord[1] for coord in near_residue_coords]
near_z = [coord[2] for coord in near_residue_coords]

# Separate far residue coordinates
far_x = [coord[0] for coord in far_residue_coords]
far_y = [coord[1] for coord in far_residue_coords]
far_z = [coord[2] for coord in far_residue_coords]

# Separate ligand coordinates
ligand_x = [coord[0] for coord in ligand_coords]
ligand_y = [coord[1] for coord in ligand_coords]
ligand_z = [coord[2] for coord in ligand_coords]

# Create 3D scatter plot with residues and ligand
fig = go.Figure(
    data=[
        # Far protein residues (not near ligand)
        go.Scatter3d(
            x=far_x,
            y=far_y,
            z=far_z,
            mode='markers',
            name='Protein Residues',
            marker=dict(
                size=5,
                opacity=0.4,
                color='gray'
            ),
            text=far_residue_labels,
            hovertemplate='<b>%{text}</b><br>X: %{x:.2f}<br>Y: %{y:.2f}<br>Z: %{z:.2f}<extra></extra>'
        ),
        # Near protein residues (within 7 Å of ligand)
        go.Scatter3d(
            x=near_x,
            y=near_y,
            z=near_z,
            mode='markers',
            name='Residues Near Ligand (≤7 Å)',
            marker=dict(
                size=6,
                opacity=0.7,
                color='green'
            ),
            text=near_residue_labels,
            hovertemplate='<b>%{text}</b><br>X: %{x:.2f}<br>Y: %{y:.2f}<br>Z: %{z:.2f}<extra></extra>'
        ),
        # Ligand atoms (IHP)
        go.Scatter3d(
            x=ligand_x,
            y=ligand_y,
            z=ligand_z,
            mode='markers',
            name='Ligand (IHP)',
            marker=dict(
                size=8,
                opacity=0.7,
                color='purple',
            ),
            text=ligand_names,
            hovertemplate='<b>%{text}</b><br>X: %{x:.2f}<br>Y: %{y:.2f}<br>Z: %{z:.2f}<extra></extra>'
        )
    ]
)

fig.update_layout(
    title=f'3D Protein Structure (1DKP) - {len(nearby_residues)} Residues Near IHP Ligand',
    scene=dict(
        xaxis_title='X (Å)',
        yaxis_title='Y (Å)',
        zaxis_title='Z (Å)',
        aspectmode='data'
    ),
    width=900,
    height=700
)

fig.show()
